# Foursquare

Foursquare provides location-based search and discovery, offering detailed venue information, place recommendations, and geospatial data for businesses and points of interest worldwide

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/foursquare/.

## Actions

- **Retrieve nearby places v3** (read-only): The getnearbyplaces endpoint retrieves a list of places near a specified location, primarily supporting check-in use cases and local…
- **Retrieve place photos by id** (read-only): Retrieves photos associated with a specific place in foursquare's database.
- **Retrieve place tips using fsq id** (read-only): Retrieves user-generated tips for a specific place in the foursquare database.
- **Retrieve places by id** (read-only): Retrieves detailed information about a specific place using its unique foursquare id (fsq id).
- **Search places api request** (read-only): The getplacessearch endpoint allows you to search for places in the foursquare database based on various criteria such as location,…
